name: Rounded Window Corners Native
description:
Rounds every window to match libadwaita, out of the box. GTK 3, GTK 4, Qt, Chromium/Electron, Firefox, Java, Wine and other apps get the same corners, outline and shadow as libadwaita apps, on Wayland or Xwayland.

The look comes from libadwaita and your ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css, so it follows light and dark, high contrast and gtk.css edits live. No GNOME Shell methods are patched, so it doesn't get in the way of docks or tiling extensions.

Optional settings:
* Choose which apps and toolkits are rounded
* Keep maximized and tiled windows rounded
* Set your own corner radius, outline and shadow, for every window or for one app or toolkit
* Choose how an app's own border is hidden
